Buyer count is broad, and the top-3 holder share (37.7%) and top-5 buyer share in the first two minutes (68%) are not extreme.

Against that, net flow over the last 15 minutes is essentially flat (+1.25 SOL on 140 SOL of volume), sellers (124) nearly match buyers, and sell-to-buy was 0.42 right after graduation. The coin is already 15% off its 30-minute high. A launch bot was present, and the completer holds a share above 1, which signals concentrated early activity. Net, this looks like churn near a plateau, not a fresh wave of demand, and a 30-60 minute hold after a dip faces the base rate of roughly -20%, before fees of 1.4-5.1%.

I see no case strong enough to override the base rate. Recommendation: skip.
